rules: One current physical location per object; carrier membership does not create a second object location
Cut rods descend from measured wire lot and cut batch; rejection never removes them from accounting
Each clamp packing links actual rod/ball charge, fixture, stick, measured volumes and preparation history
Pull-out changes insertion/packing state; reinsertion, particle loss and repacking are explicit transitions
A repack creates a new packing_id; cannot silently inherit same-packing cycle continuity
Friction coupons and DSC subsamples are separate descendants; glued or pan-processed stock cannot silently reenter free rod packing
Every XCT rod identity is a supported registration assignment with uncertainty, not guessed from row order
A derived record requires real raw parent IDs and versioned processing; source outcome files cannot be raw parents
Retries append attempts; invalid temperature traces, missing scans and failed load holds remain visible
All descendants end in a unique supported return, retained specimen, quarantine or waste state
